Let's reconsider carefully.

The question is: "What's the only way to get a perfect SAT score?"

Options:

A. Take it twice — Taking the test multiple times can help improve your score, but you can get a perfect score on a single test. So this is not the only way.

B. Get all the questions right — The SAT score is based on the number of correct answers. To get a perfect score, you must answer all questions correctly. This is the direct and only way to get a perfect score.

C. Study all the time — Studying helps, but it is not the only way, nor a guarantee.

D. Cheat — Cheating is unethical and against rules, and not a legitimate way.

E. Go to test prep — Test prep can help, but is not the only way.

F. Remember all the answers — This is unrealistic and not the method.

Therefore, the only way to get a perfect SAT score is to get all the questions right.

Answer: B
